I am an economist at the University of Virginia focused on the economic implications of transformative AI, with particular emphasis on AI safety. My research applies tools from price theory and public finance to questions about how AI development can go well—and what policy can do to make that more likely. I also maintain an ongoing research program in social insurance and the economics of aging.

**PhD, Economics, University of Chicago**
